9bef300e-ef1e-469f-bbc6-51150d229421/Eve.en: For a long time <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gets no word from Bai Wuyang...<NL>Recalling the strange manner in which she left that day, his heart fills with unease...<NL><NL>After a moment's thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> entrusts others to scour every corner for any trace of Bai Wuyang...
9bef300e-ef1e-469f-bbc6-51150d229421/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>许久不得白无恙前辈音讯，<NL>想及那日她临走之时的异状，不免忧心忡忡，<NL><NL>稍作思虑，便即托人四处寻找白无恙前辈的踪迹……

081177b7-1785-4b4b-96ef-7c9adbd5cf1f/Eve.en: Some time later,<NL>the scouts sent by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> to seek news of Bai Wuyang at last deliver a letter:<NL><NL>The search yields no direct sign of Bai Wuyang,<NL>but during their inquiries around <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/> - <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> they hear of a bizarre "Heart-stealing Murderer,"<NL>whose perpetrator bears some resemblance to the Bai Wuyang mentioned by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
081177b7-1785-4b4b-96ef-7c9adbd5cf1f/Eve.cn: 一段时日过后，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>派出打探白无恙消息之人，终于传来书信：<NL><NL>原来众人虽未寻到白无恙前辈的踪迹，<NL>却于<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>探听到了一桩“杀人夺心”的奇闻，<NL>其中所牵涉之人，倒与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>口中所言的白无恙有几分相似……

8f8b8415-235a-415e-a973-f2d0e03f6682/Eve.en: Rumor spreads through the Martial World:<NL>Recently, one martial artist after another is struck down in secret across the <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/> - <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>...<NL>Each victim is found with chest torn open and viscera removed—<NL>the scene so horrific to see, so dreadful to hear...<NL><NL>And all agree the culprit is a white-robed girl!
8f8b8415-235a-415e-a973-f2d0e03f6682/Eve.cn: 江湖传闻，<NL>近日不断有武林人士于<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>遭到暗害，<NL>而这些受害之人，死后皆被开膛剖腹，掏空五脏六腑，<NL>死状之凄惨，令人目不忍见，耳不堪闻……<NL><NL>而听闻犯下这一系列血案的元凶，正是一名白衣少女！

8f8b8415-235a-415e-a973-f2d0e03f6682/Opt.en: "Chest torn open... viscera... a white-robed girl..."
8f8b8415-235a-415e-a973-f2d0e03f6682/Opt.cn: 开膛剖腹……五腑六脏……白衣少女……
8f8b8415-235a-415e-a973-f2d0e03f6682/Opt.ru: "Грудная клетка разорвана... Внутренности... Девушка в белом одеянии..."

519ee8fa-2490-49c4-b8e0-bba6609019f9/Eve.en: A chill runs through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> recalls how Bai Wuyang once healed <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/><NL>by opening chest and resetting zang-fu organs—<NL><NL>and since parting from White Deer Marsh Village,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has heard naught of her...<NL>Could it truly... be linked to her?
519ee8fa-2490-49c4-b8e0-bba6609019f9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头一震，<NL>思及此前白无恙前辈为自己施医之时，<NL>使得正是开胸剖腹，重整腑脏的手段，<NL><NL>而自白鹿泽村庄一别，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便再未听闻白无恙前辈的音讯，<NL>莫非……此事果真与她相关么？

519ee8fa-2490-49c4-b8e0-bba6609019f9/Opt.en: (Though her methods are strange, a medical learner's heart is kind; she would never kill...)
519ee8fa-2490-49c4-b8e0-bba6609019f9/Opt.cn: （白无恙前辈虽行事古怪，然医者仁心，断不会杀人害命……）
519ee8fa-2490-49c4-b8e0-bba6609019f9/Opt.ru: (Хотя ее методы странны, сердце у студентки медицинского факультета доброе; она никогда бы не убила...)

809b40d3-bc81-4a1c-a7d0-bb0fe41e644f/Eve.en: Convinced this cannot be Bai Wuyang's doing,<NL>yet certain of some connection, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> resolves to investigate—<NL>to spare innocents in <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> further terror, and to seek out Bai Wuyang herself...<NL><NL>Prepared,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sets off for <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/> - <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> to probe this "Heart-stealing Murderer"!
809b40d3-bc81-4a1c-a7d0-bb0fe41e644f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽觉此事并非白无恙前辈所为，<NL>但与其却有几分关联，倒不妨一探究竟，<NL>一来可为<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>百姓除去一患，二则也可寻访白无恙前辈……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中想定，一番准备过后，<NL>便要前往<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>查探这“杀人夺心”之凶案！

8404e31c-de4d-4e12-9348-58b3ac3281a9/Eve.en: Under a bright moon and gentle breeze, the night seems fair,<NL>yet <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind is weighed by the bloody mystery...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finds a companion of <FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> to draw out the culprit,<NL>hoping to learn whether Bai Wuyang truly lies behind these crimes—but even now, they have found nothing...
8404e31c-de4d-4e12-9348-58b3ac3281a9/Eve.cn: 正是月白风清，良夜动人，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>却因心系“杀人夺心”凶案，忧愁暗生，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>寻觅<FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/>之人同行，旨在引出“杀人夺心”之元凶，<NL>查明此间内情是否真与白无恙前辈相关，可时至今日，仍是一无所获……

8404e31c-de4d-4e12-9348-58b3ac3281a9/Opt.en: (Perhaps the time is not yet ripe...)

3c10617e-7be2-4b13-856b-93c68bc95bb8/Eve.en: Lost in thought,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly notices trembling shadows among the blossoms and a faint "ho-ho" breathing...<NL>Startled, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> moves forward to investigate,<NL><NL>when a white figure springs from the blooms, flashes past <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>and darts straight toward <Character key=GroupId str=Name/> behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>!
3c10617e-7be2-4b13-856b-93c68bc95bb8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正自思索之际，<NL>忽见前方花影摇动，其中传来极轻微的“嗬嗬”之声，<NL>不由得一怔，正欲上前探个究竟，<NL><NL>蓦地一道白影自花间跃出，径直越过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>直冲<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身后的<Character key=GroupId str=Name/>而去！

3c10617e-7be2-4b13-856b-93c68bc95bb8/Opt.en: The murderer at last reveals themselves!

0a80fe38-3895-40c8-a3b4-35387366d6ac/Eve.en: Instantly <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> springs into footwork, pursuing and intercepting the fiend with a horizontal sweep of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> palm!<NL><NL>The culprit's path is blocked; they pause and lift their head toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finds them stained in blood, hair disheveled, their clear-cold eyes strike familiarity—<NL>it is none other than the long-missing Bai Wuyang!
0a80fe38-3895-40c8-a3b4-35387366d6ac/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>当即运起身法，直追而上，横手拦下元凶！<NL><NL>元凶去路被拦，止步原处，抬起头来看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>但见此人满身血污，蓬头垢面，一双青眸清寒慑人，似曾相识， <NL>岂不正是失踪已久的白无恙前辈！

2f704cb6-a3fc-4b3e-a0e6-1c2acf280b7a/Eve.en: The mastermind behind the bloodshed... it's really Bai Wuyang!<NL>The truth shocks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> so deeply that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> stumbles back in stunned silence...
2f704cb6-a3fc-4b3e-a0e6-1c2acf280b7a/Eve.cn: 血案元凶，竟果真是白无恙前辈！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头巨震，倒退数步，一时顿口无言……

2f704cb6-a3fc-4b3e-a0e6-1c2acf280b7a/Opt.en: (Master Bai... why have you come to this?)
2f704cb6-a3fc-4b3e-a0e6-1c2acf280b7a/Opt.ru: (Мастер Бай... зачем вы пришли к этому?)

467596f5-c1bb-4f84-a8f2-e2fb85112edd/Eve.en: At that moment, Bai Wuyang tilts her head,<NL>reaches a hand as if to touch <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, then swiftly withdraws it:<NL><NL>"Ho-ho...<NL><FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> Qi... can boost the Hands of Salvation... and then... then no one may not be saved...<NL>Qing'er... Qing'er... wait just a little longer..."
467596f5-c1bb-4f84-a8f2-e2fb85112edd/Eve.cn: 这时，却见白无恙微微偏头，<NL>伸出手似想要触碰<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，但旋即便又很快收回：<NL><NL>“嗬嗬……<NL><FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/>内力……可强神手……神手得进……再无难救……<NL>青儿……青儿……你再等等……”

a387e2b7-504b-42d9-bb5b-98471a79844d/Eve.en: "If my Hands of Salvation reach yet higher... perhaps no more will perish..."<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang's parting words still linger...<NL>Could Bai Wuyang has succumbed to madness over Feng Qing's matter, her heart led deviated into obsession...?<NL>Thinking of this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees a dark aura erupt from her chest,<NL>coiling into countless tendrils that shroud her!<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang's blue eyes glow red as she bares her claws,<NL>and launches herself at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>!
a387e2b7-504b-42d9-bb5b-98471a79844d/Eve.cn: “若我无恙神手更进一步……或许，便不再有人丧命……”<NL><NL>往日临别之言，依稀在耳，<NL>莫非白无恙前辈因冯青之事，偏生迷，迷生执，终于入魔……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>此念一出，忽见一道黑气忽自白无恙心口涌出，<NL>霎时化作万缕千丝，将白无恙笼罩其中！<NL><NL>白无恙一双青目染上血色，伸出利爪，<NL>向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>袭杀而来！

3df6f9e8-824c-4f4f-a97f-f22e72dc6cf5/Eve.en: Though Bai Wuyang excels in medical arts, her martial skill cannot match <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s,<NL>and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> fells her into a pool of blood. While her mind is still clouded,<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> grips the Fuyu Hilt in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> left hand, recites the mantra,<NL>and stabs three times into Bai Wuyang's brow with the Fuyu Hilt!
3df6f9e8-824c-4f4f-a97f-f22e72dc6cf5/Eve.cn: 白无恙虽精擅医术，然武艺一道，却难敌<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将白无恙击倒在一片血泊当中，趁其神智未复之际，<NL><NL>左手持伏虞，口中念真诀，<NL>以伏虞剑柄在白无恙眉心点刺了三下！

3df6f9e8-824c-4f4f-a97f-f22e72dc6cf5/Opt.en: (The mantra was laid with subtle grace, yet every word strikes true and deep in the mind!)
3df6f9e8-824c-4f4f-a97f-f22e72dc6cf5/Opt.ru: (Мантра была написана с тонким изяществом, но при этом каждое слово звучит правдиво и глубоко врезается в сознание!)

116cf45e-9579-4f08-bc95-a90fa42b46be/Eve.en: Bai Wuyang fells <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> into a pool of blood...<NL><NL>In <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> haze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> glimpses Bai Wuyang kneeling beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>,<NL>whispering something before letting tears fall upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s cheek...
116cf45e-9579-4f08-bc95-a90fa42b46be/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被白无恙击倒在一片血泊当中……<NL><NL>迷蒙之中，似见白无恙跪倒于自己身侧，不知说了什么，<NL>忽而垂下数滴清泪，落在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>脸颊……

d6e886b1-efec-42de-8649-007fee05cfd4/Eve.en: With those three stabs—each differing in strength, timing, and direction—<NL>the dark aura around Bai Wuyang dissipates, her expression returning to calm...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> exhales in relief, reaching to help her up,<NL>when suddenly a strange transformation occurs:<NL>Bai Wuyang is enveloped in a thousand brilliant auras, dazzling and divine...
d6e886b1-efec-42de-8649-007fee05cfd4/Eve.cn: 随着这三下轻重、缓急、方位全不相同的点刺，<NL>白无恙周身黑气消弭无踪，神色亦渐复如常……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>长舒口气，正欲上前扶起白无恙，<NL>谁知便在此时，异变突生，但见白无恙周身散出万道灵光，<NL>赫赫煌煌，眩目迷神……

d6e886b1-efec-42de-8649-007fee05cfd4/Opt.en: Dark aura is gone—yet a new wonder unfolds?
d6e886b1-efec-42de-8649-007fee05cfd4/Opt.cn: 黑气既已消失，怎还有变故？
d6e886b1-efec-42de-8649-007fee05cfd4/Opt.ru: Темная аура исчезла — и все же открывается новое чудо?

8322e029-b628-4821-a983-7ed414544a87/Eve.en: Startled and inwardly questioning, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cannot approach<NL>as the radiance sears <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes...<NL><NL>After a moment the light fades,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> opens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes to find, in the pool of blood, no trace of Bai Wuyang—<NL>only a small deer of pure white, whose antlers resemble jade branches and whose flanks bear crimson lotus markings, lying there...
8322e029-b628-4821-a983-7ed414544a87/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下既惊又疑，<NL>但因灵光刺目，一时难以上前查看……<NL><NL>待得片刻，灵光渐泯，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>睁开双目，却见前方血泊当中，已不见白无恙身影，<NL>唯有一只通体雪白，角若玉枝，体覆赤色莲纹的小鹿盘卧在地……

8322e029-b628-4821-a983-7ed414544a87/Opt.en: Master Bai... has she become the White Deer...?
8322e029-b628-4821-a983-7ed414544a87/Opt.cn: 白无恙前辈……化作白鹿了么……
8322e029-b628-4821-a983-7ed414544a87/Opt.ru: Мастер Бай... неужели она превратилась в Белого Оленя?..

89bde0dd-09aa-48d1-98ca-6ae5a91803f3/Eve.en: In the Valley of Flowers, the White Deer and the Dark Owl heal the people, relieving suffering...<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang and Xuan Wuyou turn out to be the Dark Owl & White Deer,<NL>and that her madness inflicts such harm to her mind that she reverts to her true form—<NL>even the Fuyu Hilt's rescue cannot restore her former self...<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ponders this,<NL>the White Deer slowly opens its eyes, shakily rises upon trembling legs...
89bde0dd-09aa-48d1-98ca-6ae5a91803f3/Eve.cn: 百花谷中，白鹿玄鸮，授民以医，救苦解难……<NL><NL>白无恙、玄无忧前辈原就是白鹿、玄鸮所化而成，<NL>想来此番白无恙前辈执迷入魔，以致神智受损，灵气弥散，化作原形，<NL>纵得伏虞所救，也难以恢复如初……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正自思索之际，<NL>那白鹿忽而睁开双目，颤颤巍巍地站立起来……

89bde0dd-09aa-48d1-98ca-6ae5a91803f3/Opt.cn: 白无恙前辈，你可安好？（走上前去……）
89bde0dd-09aa-48d1-98ca-6ae5a91803f3/Opt.ru: "Мастер Бай, с вами все в порядке?" (Приближается...)

d262fa2b-e967-463b-b7d2-03722ae304df/Eve.en: Hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words,<NL>the White Deer turns its head to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and rouses its spirit,<NL>as though to assure <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> it suffers no grave injury...<NL><NL>Though now a White Deer,<NL>her lingering aura of compassion outshines ordinary beasts,<NL>which brings <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> a measure of comfort, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> continues...
d262fa2b-e967-463b-b7d2-03722ae304df/Eve.cn: 听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之言，<NL>白鹿偏头看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，抖擞身躯，<NL>似是在告知<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>自己并无大碍……<NL><NL>白无恙前辈虽然化为白鹿，<NL>但其负气含灵，却胜过寻常禽兽，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思及此处，稍感欣慰，继续说道……

d262fa2b-e967-463b-b7d2-03722ae304df/Opt.en: It may be hard for you out here—let me bring you back to the Valley of Flowers, where the disciples can care for you.
d262fa2b-e967-463b-b7d2-03722ae304df/Opt.cn: 前辈在外只恐不便，不如在下将你送回百花谷，由谷中弟子照料……
d262fa2b-e967-463b-b7d2-03722ae304df/Opt.ru: Возможно, вам здесь тяжело — позвольте мне вернуть вас в Долину цветов, где ученики смогут позаботиться о вас.

8f700f98-41ba-4570-9085-2ece48c44fbb/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finishes speaking,<NL>the White Deer's eyes flash with alarm and it stumbles back several paces.<NL>Reading her intent, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> comes to realize—<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang, true to her healer's heart,<NL>has, by a single misstep, fallen into corruption. Her very Hands of Salvation now bring death with ruthless precision.<NL>Though her mind is lost, the burden of regret and sorrow clings to her still, as though carved into his very soul.<NL>Shamed beyond measure, she would rather not return to the Valley of Flowers.
8f700f98-41ba-4570-9085-2ece48c44fbb/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>说罢，<NL>却见白鹿目露惊恐，踉踉跄跄地倒退数步，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见白鹿此状，稍作揣度，便知其一二心意——<NL><NL>白无恙前辈本是医者仁心，<NL>谁知一念之差，堕入魔道，一双无恙神手竟作夺命血手，<NL>纵然无人之心智，但这千般懊悔，万般痛惜，却仍是难以忘怀，<NL>是以自觉再无面目回到百花谷……

8f700f98-41ba-4570-9085-2ece48c44fbb/Opt.en: In that case, you might as well travel with me for now...
8f700f98-41ba-4570-9085-2ece48c44fbb/Opt.cn: 既然如此，不如白无恙前辈且先与我同行……
8f700f98-41ba-4570-9085-2ece48c44fbb/Opt.ru: В таком случае, вы могли бы пока поехать со мной...

571404ee-b165-40ad-87f4-f89a0dc6656b/Eve.en: At this offer,<NL>the White Deer slowly steps toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and gently touches <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hand with its antlers,<NL>signifying its willingness to accompany <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
571404ee-b165-40ad-87f4-f89a0dc6656b/Eve.cn: 白鹿听闻此言，<NL>徐徐踱步至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，轻轻以双角触摸<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手背，<NL>自是愿与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>同行之意……

b70eb344-b849-4ab7-b80d-f96a5ffe0934/Eve.en: Now that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has found the White Deer,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> must swiftly seek out Xuan Wuyou...<NL><NL>After preparations, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sets out,<NL>the White Deer bearing a blossom in its mouth follows at his side, bleating softly...
b70eb344-b849-4ab7-b80d-f96a5ffe0934/Eve.cn: 而今既已寻见白鹿，<NL>还需尽快探寻玄无忧前辈之踪迹……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一番准备后，便即上路，<NL>身后一只白鹿衔花缓行，呦呦而鸣……

52716ed2-cefc-4ced-9d2d-0f9144969b8c/Eve.en: Since both Xuan Wuyou and Bai Wuyang are found,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> may bring them to Taiwu Village, that they may rest from their journey...<NL><NL>Resolving this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> departs,<NL>the White Deer trailing behind with a flower in its mouth, and the Dark Owl circling overhead, hooting in reply...
52716ed2-cefc-4ced-9d2d-0f9144969b8c/Eve.cn: 既已寻到玄无忧、白无恙前辈，<NL>或可将他们安置于太吾村，以免奔波之苦……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中想定，便即上路，<NL>身后一只白鹿衔花缓行，呦呦而鸣；一只玄鸮飞高飞低，咕咕相应……

0423001e-3c3b-444c-8489-316577f0eede/Eve.en: For a long time <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gets no word from Xuan Wuyou...<NL>Recalling the strange manner in which he left that day, his heart fills with unease...<NL><NL>After a moment's thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> entrusts others to scour every corner for any trace of Xuan Wuyou...
0423001e-3c3b-444c-8489-316577f0eede/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>许久不得玄无忧前辈音讯，<NL>想及那日他临走之时的异状，不免忧心忡忡，<NL><NL>稍作思虑之后，便即托人四处寻找玄无忧前辈的踪迹……

79065847-a8db-43fa-849d-c4781580072b/Eve.en: Some time later,<NL>the scouts sent by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> to seek news of Xuan Wuyou at last deliver a letter:<NL><NL>The search yields no direct sign of Xuan Wuyou,<NL>but during their inquiries around <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/> - <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> they hear of a bizarre "soul-shatterer,"<NL>whose perpetrator bears some resemblance to the Xuan Wuyou mentioned by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
79065847-a8db-43fa-849d-c4781580072b/Eve.cn: 一段时日过后，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>派出打探玄无忧消息之人，终于传来书信：<NL><NL>原来众人虽未寻到玄无忧前辈的踪迹，<NL>却于<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>探听到了一桩“摧神乱智”的奇闻，<NL>其中所牵涉之人，倒与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>口中所言的玄无忧有几分相似……

b4c1dd49-5edd-45bc-9e2a-50bcf9b85a4f/Eve.en: Rumor spreads through the Martial World:<NL>Recently, one martial artist after another is struck down in secret across the <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/> - <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>...<NL>Those found seem to have had their very souls stolen, reduced to vacant, childlike daze...<NL>the scene so horrific to see, so dreadful to hear...<NL><NL>And all agree the culprit is a black-clad young boy!
b4c1dd49-5edd-45bc-9e2a-50bcf9b85a4f/Eve.cn: 江湖传闻，<NL>近日不断有武林人士于<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>遭到暗害，<NL>而那些受害之人，皆好似被人摄去魂魄，就此变得痴呆懵懂，宛如三岁幼童，<NL>情态之悲惨，令人目不忍见，耳不堪闻……<NL><NL>而听闻犯下这一系列惨案的元凶，正是一名黑衣少年！

b4c1dd49-5edd-45bc-9e2a-50bcf9b85a4f/Opt.en: "Soul stolen... vacant minds... a black-clad young boy?"
b4c1dd49-5edd-45bc-9e2a-50bcf9b85a4f/Opt.cn: 摄去魂魄……痴呆懵懂……黑衣少年……
b4c1dd49-5edd-45bc-9e2a-50bcf9b85a4f/Opt.ru: "Похищена душа... пустые умы... Мальчик в черном?"

caa755c8-8a67-4774-b413-ffbae1b446c0/Eve.en: A chill runs through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> recalls how Xuan Wuyou once healed steadies <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind<NL>with silver needles to clear <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> spirit...—<NL><NL>and since parting from White Deer Marsh Village,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has heard naught of him...<NL>Could it truly... be linked to him?
caa755c8-8a67-4774-b413-ffbae1b446c0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头一震，<NL>思及此前玄无忧前辈为自己施医之时，<NL>曾以银针助自己坚定心志，清明神意……<NL><NL>而自白鹿泽村庄一别，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便再未听闻玄无忧前辈的音讯，<NL>莫非……此事果真与他相关么？

caa755c8-8a67-4774-b413-ffbae1b446c0/Opt.en: (Xuan Wuyou's gentle nature and healer's heart run against such slaughter...)
caa755c8-8a67-4774-b413-ffbae1b446c0/Opt.cn: （玄无忧前辈温润敦厚，医者仁心，断不会杀人害命……）
caa755c8-8a67-4774-b413-ffbae1b446c0/Opt.ru: (Мягкая натура Сюань У Ю и сердце целителя противостоят такой бойне...)

d880256c-2f5d-4566-81d0-d84648b24c6b/Eve.en: Convinced this cannot be Xuan Wuyou's doing,<NL>yet certain of some connection, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> resolves to investigate—<NL>to spare innocents in <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> further terror, and to seek out Xuan Wuyou herself...<NL><NL>Prepared,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sets off for <MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/> - <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/> to probe this "soul-shatterer"!
d880256c-2f5d-4566-81d0-d84648b24c6b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽觉此事并非玄无忧前辈所为，<NL>但与其却有几分关联，倒不妨一探究竟，<NL>一来可为<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>百姓除去一患，二则也可寻访玄无忧前辈……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中想定，一番准备过后，<NL>便要前往<MapArea key=AreaId str=Name/>-<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>查探这“摧神乱智”之凶案！

a8d1cbf3-fa48-4531-be5e-7a5b18328b95/Eve.en: Midnight deepens and the world lies hushed,<NL>but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, whose mind is fixed on the "soul-shatterer," sleeps not...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finds a companion of <FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> to draw out the culprit,<NL>hoping to learn whether Xuan Wuyou truly lies behind these crimes—but even now, they have found nothing...
a8d1cbf3-fa48-4531-be5e-7a5b18328b95/Eve.cn: 正是子夜更鸣，万物沉寂，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>却因心系“摧神乱智”惨案，无心入睡，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>寻觅<FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/>之人同行，旨在引出“摧神乱智”之元凶，<NL>查明此间内情是否真与玄无忧前辈相关，可时至今日，仍是一无所获……

a8d1cbf3-fa48-4531-be5e-7a5b18328b95/Opt.en: (Perhaps the time is not yet ripe...)

78e3c489-4681-4cc4-9879-a54ae180c086/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> contemplates the matter...<NL>Suddenly, the cry of an owl and the screech of a hawk pierce the air. Branches sway, startled birds scatter from the forest.<NL><NL>A dark blur bursts forth from nowhere, soaring past <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>heading straight toward <Character key=GroupId str=Name/> behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>!
78e3c489-4681-4cc4-9879-a54ae180c086/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正自思索之际，<NL>忽听得鸮啼鹰鸣，又见枝叶摇摇，飞鸟出林，<NL><NL>蓦地一道黑影不知自何处飞出，径直越过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>直冲<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身后的<Character key=GroupId str=Name/>而去！

78e3c489-4681-4cc4-9879-a54ae180c086/Opt.en: At last, the true culprit reveals themselves!

5cc0f07d-1c26-4031-aac6-a84e7aa3b041/Eve.en: Instantly <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> springs into footwork, pursuing and intercepting the fiend with a horizontal sweep of his palm!<NL><NL>The culprit's path is blocked. The figure halts in its tracks, gazing blankly at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees its tattered robes, dazed eyes, a face round as the full moon—<NL>it is none other than the long-missing Xuan Wuyou!
5cc0f07d-1c26-4031-aac6-a84e7aa3b041/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>当即运起身法，直追而上，横手拦下元凶！<NL><NL>元凶去路被拦，抬头痴痴看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>但见身前此人，衣衫残破，眼转迷离，一张面庞，犹如满月，<NL>岂不正是失踪已久的玄无忧前辈！

0dfd1b9a-7131-4bd2-a769-f1bf80e900ef/Eve.en: The mastermind behind the bloodshed... it's really Master... Xuan!<NL><NL>The truth shocks <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> so deeply that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> stumbles back in stunned silence...
0dfd1b9a-7131-4bd2-a769-f1bf80e900ef/Eve.cn: 惨案元凶，竟果真是玄无忧前辈！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心头巨震，倒退数步，一时顿口无言……

0dfd1b9a-7131-4bd2-a769-f1bf80e900ef/Opt.en: (Master Xuan... why have you come to this?)
0dfd1b9a-7131-4bd2-a769-f1bf80e900ef/Opt.ru: (Мастер Сюань... почему вы пришли к этому?)

35bb25fc-0362-434d-8419-b9e989a741bd/Eve.en: At that moment, Xuan Wuyou parts his lips in what seems a smile—<NL>but his vacant eyes and stiff expression render the gesture uncanny and grotesque:<NL><NL>"Heh-Heh...<NL><FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> Qi... can boost the Needles of Tranquility... and then... then no one may not be saved...<NL>Qing'er... Qing'er... wait just a little longer..."
35bb25fc-0362-434d-8419-b9e989a741bd/Eve.cn: 这时，只见玄无忧扯开嘴角，似在微笑，<NL>但因其神情呆滞，却显得极是诡异可怖：<NL><NL>“嗬嗬……<NL><FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/>内力……可强神针……神针得进……再无难救……<NL>青儿……青儿……你再等等……”

5d77596d-f06a-4354-b5a2-6140b68482d2/Eve.en: "If my Needles of Tranquility reach yet higher... perhaps no more will perish..."<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang's parting words still linger...<NL>Could Xuan Wuyou has succumbed to madness over Feng Qing's matter, his heart led deviated into obsession...?<NL>Thinking of this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees a dark aura erupt from his chest,<NL><NL>coiling into countless tendrils that shroud him!<NL>Xuan Wuyou's twisted smile vanishes as he lets out a furious roar, and hurls himself at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>!
5d77596d-f06a-4354-b5a2-6140b68482d2/Eve.cn: “若我无忧神针更进一步……或许，便不再有人丧命……”<NL><NL>往日临别之言，依稀在耳，<NL>莫非玄无忧因冯青之事，偏生迷，迷生执，终于入魔……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>此念一出，忽见一道黑气忽自玄无忧心口涌出，<NL>霎时化作万缕千丝，将玄无忧笼罩其中！<NL><NL>玄无忧收敛笑意，猛地发出一声暴喝，<NL>向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>袭杀而来！

0468726a-e26c-44be-8a33-2d6041a69e4b/Eve.en: Though Xuan Wuyou excels in medical arts, his martial skill cannot match <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s,<NL>and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> fells him into a pool of blood. While his mind is still clouded,<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> grips the Fuyu Hilt in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> left hand, recites the mantra,<NL>and stabs three times into Xuan Wuyou's brow with the Fuyu Hilt!
0468726a-e26c-44be-8a33-2d6041a69e4b/Eve.cn: 玄无忧虽精擅医术，然武艺一道，却难敌<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将玄无忧击倒在一片血泊当中，趁其神智未复之际，<NL><NL>左手持伏虞，口中念真诀，<NL>以伏虞剑柄在玄无忧眉心点刺了三下！

0468726a-e26c-44be-8a33-2d6041a69e4b/Opt.en: (The mantra was laid with subtle grace, yet every word strikes true and deep in the mind!)
0468726a-e26c-44be-8a33-2d6041a69e4b/Opt.ru: (Мантра была написана с тонким изяществом, но при этом каждое слово звучит правдиво и глубоко врезается в сознание!)

8325fba5-f5ce-488b-8f65-f81e7f4c3a32/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou fells <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> into a pool of blood...<NL><NL>In <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> haze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> glimpses Xuan Wuyou sitting beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, whispering something.<NL>Then, his hand reaches out, gently brushing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s cheek...
8325fba5-f5ce-488b-8f65-f81e7f4c3a32/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>被玄无忧击倒在一片血泊当中……<NL><NL>迷蒙之中，似见玄无忧坐于自己身侧，不知说了什么，<NL>忽而伸出手来，轻轻抚过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>面颊……

da4cb03b-1fc1-42f2-9c04-7f7baf5fe8b1/Eve.en: With those three stabs—each differing in strength, timing, and direction—<NL>the dark aura around Xuan Wuyou dissipates, his expression returning to calm...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> exhales in relief, reaching to help him up,<NL>when suddenly a strange transformation occurs:<NL>Xuan Wuyou is enveloped in a thousand brilliant auras, dazzling and divine...
da4cb03b-1fc1-42f2-9c04-7f7baf5fe8b1/Eve.cn: 随着这三下轻重、缓急、方位全不相同的点刺，<NL>玄无忧周身黑气消弭无踪，神色亦渐复如常……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>长舒口气，正欲上前扶起玄无忧，<NL>谁知便在此时，异变突生，但见玄无忧周身散出万道灵光，<NL>赫赫煌煌，眩目迷神……

da4cb03b-1fc1-42f2-9c04-7f7baf5fe8b1/Opt.en: But the Evil Qi has been dispelled—why now this?
da4cb03b-1fc1-42f2-9c04-7f7baf5fe8b1/Opt.cn: 魔气既除，怎会还有变故？
da4cb03b-1fc1-42f2-9c04-7f7baf5fe8b1/Opt.ru: Но злая Ци была рассеяна — к чему теперь это?

48ba989b-f15c-4ccc-b8db-89deba46b7aa/Eve.en: Startled and inwardly questioning, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cannot approach<NL>as the radiance sears <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes...<NL><NL>After a moment the light fades,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> opens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes to find, in the pool of blood, no trace of Xuan Wuyou—<NL>only an owl with elegant ear tufts and inky-black feathers lie on the ground...
48ba989b-f15c-4ccc-b8db-89deba46b7aa/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下既惊又疑，<NL>但因灵光刺目，一时难以上前查看……<NL><NL>待得片刻，灵光渐泯，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>睁开双目，却见前方血泊当中，已不见玄无忧身影，<NL>唯有一只体形魁伟，耳羽飘逸，翅羽墨黑的玄鸮躺倒在地……

48ba989b-f15c-4ccc-b8db-89deba46b7aa/Opt.en: Has Master Xuan... become the Dark Owl once more?
48ba989b-f15c-4ccc-b8db-89deba46b7aa/Opt.cn: 玄无忧前辈……化作玄鸮了么……
48ba989b-f15c-4ccc-b8db-89deba46b7aa/Opt.ru: Неужели мастер Сюань... снова стал Темной Совой?

27512e60-3e92-4a02-8fee-de373765f3b3/Eve.en: In the Valley of Flowers, the White Deer and the Dark Owl heal the people, relieving suffering...<NL><NL>Bai Wuyang and Xuan Wuyou turn out to be the Dark Owl & White Deer,<NL>and that his madness inflicts such harm to his mind that he reverts to his true form—<NL>even the Fuyu Hilt's rescue cannot restore his former self...<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ponders this,<NL>the Dark Owl slowly opens its eyes, shakes its feathers, and stands...
27512e60-3e92-4a02-8fee-de373765f3b3/Eve.cn: 百花谷中，白鹿玄鸮，授民以医，救苦解难……<NL><NL>白无恙、玄无忧前辈原就是白鹿、玄鸮所化而成，<NL>想来此番玄无忧前辈执迷入魔，以致神智受损，灵气弥散，化作原形，<NL>纵得伏虞所救，也难以恢复如初……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正自思索之际，<NL>那玄鸮忽而睁开双目，抖擞翅膀，站起身来……

27512e60-3e92-4a02-8fee-de373765f3b3/Opt.cn: 玄无忧前辈，你可安好？（走上前去……）
27512e60-3e92-4a02-8fee-de373765f3b3/Opt.ru: - Мастер Сюань, с вами все в порядке? (Приближаюсь...)

3f30474c-b1bd-432c-a5cf-7fba43cccb64/Eve.en: Hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words,<NL>the Dark Owl stretches its neck and flutters its wings,<NL>as though to assure <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> it suffers no grave injury...<NL><NL>Though now an Dark Owl,<NL>his lingering aura of compassion outshines ordinary beasts,<NL>which brings <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> a measure of comfort, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> continues...
3f30474c-b1bd-432c-a5cf-7fba43cccb64/Eve.cn: 听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之言，<NL>玄鸮伸展脖颈，扑扇着翅膀，<NL>似是在告知<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>自己并无大碍……<NL><NL>玄无忧前辈虽然化为玄鸮，<NL>但其负气含灵，却胜过寻常禽兽，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思及此处，稍感欣慰，继续说道……

3f30474c-b1bd-432c-a5cf-7fba43cccb64/Opt.en: It may be inconvenient for you to wander—let me return you to the Valley of Flowers, where the disciples can tend to you...
3f30474c-b1bd-432c-a5cf-7fba43cccb64/Opt.cn: 前辈在外只恐不便，不如在下将你送回百花谷，由谷中弟子照料……
3f30474c-b1bd-432c-a5cf-7fba43cccb64/Opt.ru: Возможно, вам неудобно бродить — позвольте мне вернуть вас в Долину цветов, где ученики смогут позаботиться о вас...

aeced129-501d-4ae3-bb76-b57caa0910bf/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finishes speaking,<NL>the Dark Owl falters and retreats several steps.<NL>Reading his intent, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> comes to realize—<NL><NL>Master... Xuan, true to his healer's heart,<NL>has, by a single misstep, fallen into corruption. His very Needles of Tranquility now become instruments of death.<NL>Though his mind is lost, the burden of regret and sorrow clings to him still, as though carved into his very soul.<NL>Shamed beyond measure, he would rather not return to the Valley of Flowers.

52fbd89c-7f9b-4d01-9e06-df8c26e28233/Eve.cn: 玄鸮听闻此言，<NL>缓缓踱步至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，以鸮首轻轻蹭了蹭<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的手背，<NL>自是愿与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>同行之意……

c4b37e2e-ee31-4f9f-ad2d-7256e6e616bb/Opt.en: (Small in stature... clad in white... sounds not unlike Bai Wuyang...)

faf1ac70-c016-41d8-8256-03aa809f1f73/Eve.ru: Темная Сова смотрит на <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> в тишине...

317dc834-fa47-4364-ba22-cbc256521a42/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> offers <Item key=SelectItemKey str=ColorName/> to the Dark Owl.<NL>The owl draws near, brushing its beak gently against <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hand,<NL>as if understanding <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s intent... or perhaps it simply wishes to express its thanks to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL><NL>It then carefully takes <Item key=SelectItemKey str=ColorName/>, seemingly intending to store it away...
317dc834-fa47-4364-ba22-cbc256521a42/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将<Item key=SelectItemKey str=ColorName/>递向玄鸮，<NL>玄鸮随即靠近，以喙轻蹭<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之手，<NL>似是知晓<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之意，又似欲向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>表达谢意。<NL><NL>此后，玄鸮才缓缓衔去<Item key=SelectItemKey str=ColorName/>，似乎意欲将其储藏起来……

a2aaecf1-7b47-48f5-abb0-2f9c29db69c6/Eve.en: The Dark Owl tilts its head and blinks, not understanding <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s gesture...
a2aaecf1-7b47-48f5-abb0-2f9c29db69c6/Eve.cn: 玄鸮歪头眨眼，不解<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之意……
a2aaecf1-7b47-48f5-abb0-2f9c29db69c6/Eve.ru: Темная сова наклоняет голову и моргает, не понимая <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>это жест...

a72091ff-d950-4ea2-aed7-4c7497857efb/Eve.en: No matter how <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> calls,<NL>the White Deer offers no reply.<NL>Fear grips it utterly—even toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, so familiar and trusted, it shows no response...
a72091ff-d950-4ea2-aed7-4c7497857efb/Eve.cn: 然而，<NL>无论<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>如何呼唤，白鹿皆无回应，<NL>好似已然惊惧恐慌至极，饶是亲近如<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，白鹿此时也无心理会……

a72091ff-d950-4ea2-aed7-4c7497857efb/Opt.en: (The White Deer is terrified. Best to investigate outside...)
a72091ff-d950-4ea2-aed7-4c7497857efb/Opt.cn: （白鹿惊吓至此，不如出门查探一番……）
a72091ff-d950-4ea2-aed7-4c7497857efb/Opt.ru: (Белый Олень в ужасе. Лучше всего провести расследование снаружи...)

d8914bd0-c39a-4ede-8448-6357d39dcaff/Eve.en: Seeing the White Deer so stricken,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> steps outside to investigate.<NL>Peering into the distance, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> catches a glint—hidden deep in the shadows of the forest, a pair of glowing eyes watches the cottage intently...
d8914bd0-c39a-4ede-8448-6357d39dcaff/Eve.cn: 见白鹿如此惊惧之状，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>索性迈出屋外，查探四周，<NL>凝神细望，便见远处阴翳林中，竟暗藏一双眼睛，正目不转睛地紧盯自己身后草棚……

4a38ec0b-c4b6-46dc-b3a7-b799d8b02d83/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> stays cautious and slips into the woods<NL>—only to smirk softly.<NL>It is the Dark Owl, hidden within the woodland, seemingly protecting the White Deer from the shadows.<NL>Beneath its talons lie the bodies of two or three wolves—presumably struck down by the Dark Owl's intervention...
4a38ec0b-c4b6-46dc-b3a7-b799d8b02d83/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中警惕，旋即前去查探。<NL>待得闪身探入林中，却又不由一哂：<NL>原来竟是玄鸮隐于树林，好似正暗中保护白鹿，<NL>再望向玄鸮足下，已有两三恶狼倒地不起，想来便是玄鸮出手击败……

4a38ec0b-c4b6-46dc-b3a7-b799d8b02d83/Opt.en: Such devotion in protecting the White Deer... yet it remains unaware...
4a38ec0b-c4b6-46dc-b3a7-b799d8b02d83/Opt.cn: 这番保护白鹿之心，只可惜白鹿仍不知晓……
4a38ec0b-c4b6-46dc-b3a7-b799d8b02d83/Opt.ru: Такая преданность в защите Белого Оленя... и все же он остается в неведении...

8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Eve.en: Contemplating the scene, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> realizes—<NL>though the Dark Owl stands guard from afar, the White Deer knows nothing of this. Still terrified by the beasts' howls, it remains in constant fear.<NL>If only the truth were known, and the Dark Owl could guard it more closely,<NL>perhaps the White Deer might find peace once more...
8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Eve.cn: 见此情状，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>又转念想到，<NL>虽有玄鸮暗中保护白鹿，白鹿却并不知晓此事，眼下仍因野兽嚎叫之声囿于恐惧之中。<NL>若能说清其中关窍，令玄鸮前去白鹿身边，于近处护卫，<NL>想来白鹿便能消除恐惧，安神定魄……

8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Opt.en: The White Deer remains unaware, trembling still... (Instruct the Dark Owl to stay near the White Deer...)
8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Opt.cn: 白鹿不知现状，仍然惊恐不止……（指引玄鸮，前去白鹿身旁……）
8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Opt.ru: Белый олень остается в неведении, все еще дрожа... (Проинструктируйте Темную сову оставаться рядом с Белым оленем...)

8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Opt.en: Since the Dark Owl bears this heart, nothing more is needed... (Praise the Dark Owl in silence...)
8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Opt.cn: 玄鸮既有此心，便已足矣……（赞许玄鸮，并不多言……）
8e18741f-916a-431c-b055-b12c918542dc/Opt.ru: Поскольку Темная Сова носит это сердце, больше ничего не нужно... (Восхваляйте Темную Сову в тишине...)

4ffaf08b-d984-4551-b358-aab89697fc53/Eve.en: With the Dark Owl nearby,<NL>repelling the beasts and protecting the White Deer,<NL>even if more howling come out, it will remain unharmed.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> offers quiet praise for the Dark Owl's vigilance, then turns away and departs...
4ffaf08b-d984-4551-b358-aab89697fc53/Eve.cn: 既有玄鸮在此，<NL>击退猛兽，护卫白鹿，<NL>纵有几声骇人嚎叫，白鹿亦不会受其所伤。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>放下心来，便并未多言，赞许一番玄鸮此举，便转身离开了此地……

06601b42-3e48-4e07-90d0-14e0d67a420a/Eve.en: By dawn the next day,<NL>the wild howls have ceased, yet the White Deer remains on edge.<NL>Even <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s approach causes it to flinch and retreat.<NL><NL>Only after several days of careful tending from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> does it begin to recover.<NL>Yet during this time, the Dark Owl drifts away—no longer staying near the White Deer.<NL>Their bond grows distant, unfamiliar...
06601b42-3e48-4e07-90d0-14e0d67a420a/Eve.cn: 及至次日清晨，<NL>野外再无狼嗥虎啸之声，却见白鹿仍是心神不宁，一副疑神疑鬼之相，<NL>便连<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的接近亦令其惊惧不已。<NL><NL>如此数日，经<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>悉心照料，白鹿方才抖擞精神，<NL>再观玄鸮，却逐渐不再与白鹿共处一地，二者鲜少交流，<NL>仿若已然生疏淡漠一般……

c799ddae-e052-42c9-9ce0-a7fc044858d3/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> voices <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> thoughts clearly—<NL>the White Deer trembles with fear, unable to rest.<NL>If the Dark Owl would only stay by its side, the White Deer might sleep peacefully...<NL><NL>Hearing this, the Dark Owl tilts its head,<NL>as if deep in thought...
c799ddae-e052-42c9-9ce0-a7fc044858d3/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将心中所想尽数细说，<NL>白鹿畏惧野兽嚎叫之声，如今心颤魂飞，再难安眠，<NL>若玄鸮前往白鹿身旁，于近处护卫白鹿，白鹿必能安下心来，度过今夜……<NL><NL>玄鸮听得此话，<NL>微微歪头，仿佛若有所思……

c799ddae-e052-42c9-9ce0-a7fc044858d3/Opt.en: With you nearby, the White Deer will know peace...
c799ddae-e052-42c9-9ce0-a7fc044858d3/Opt.cn: 有你相伴，白鹿必能安心无忧！
c799ddae-e052-42c9-9ce0-a7fc044858d3/Opt.ru: Когда вы будете рядом, Белый олень обретет покой...

8057484a-3996-4989-9389-b3370159d8fe/Eve.en: Suddenly, rustling from the woods—<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and the Dark Owl turn. A massive bear emerges,<NL>lumbering toward the cottage, eyes ablaze with hunger.<NL><NL>The White Deer, likely still huddled within, remains unaware of the looming danger...
8057484a-3996-4989-9389-b3370159d8fe/Eve.cn: 正在此时，忽闻一阵窸窣之声，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玄鸮转头一望，竟有一头巨熊自深林穿出，<NL>此刻已循着气味，双目如炬，摇摇晃晃地向白鹿所在的草棚走去……<NL><NL>只怕白鹿此时仍然蜷缩角落，浑然未觉草棚外已有巨熊来袭！

d86d16ef-1230-400f-a751-03db6761fa09/Eve.en: In a flash, the Dark Owl bolts forward like thunder incarnate.<NL>Gone is its usual calm—<NL>now it cries aloud and soars toward the beast!
d86d16ef-1230-400f-a751-03db6761fa09/Eve.cn: 眼前一道黑影如雷腾云奔，<NL>玄鸮此时一改往日温吞之态，<NL>竟长啸一声，旋即直冲巨熊而去！
d86d16ef-1230-400f-a751-03db6761fa09/Eve.ru: В мгновение ока Темная Сова бросается вперед, словно воплощение грома.<NL>Исчезло его обычное спокойствие—<NL>теперь он громко кричит и взмывает навстречу зверю!

68b3900b-3958-4738-9241-fdb43d5466db/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> leaps after the Dark Owl.<NL>Near the cottage, the Dark Owl spreads its wings and intercepts the bear.<NL>Feathers clash with claws—<NL><NL>one pecks, one bites. The battle rages fiercely...
68b3900b-3958-4738-9241-fdb43d5466db/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>足下轻点，紧随玄鸮而去。<NL>行至草棚近处，便见玄鸮已然直起身来，直挡在白鹿所在的草棚前方，<NL>张开双翅便与那巨熊缠斗一处！<NL><NL>一鸮猛啄，一熊撕咬，打得难分难舍，好生激烈……

5c3ca08d-665b-4d2b-8ad4-620fcf522db4/Eve.en: Such turmoil stirs even the White Deer.<NL>Jolted awake, it bursts from the cottage. Though still fearful,<NL>it charges headlong into the fray, fighting beside the Dark Owl...<NL><NL>Together they drive the bear back. The beast falters, then flees into the forest...
5c3ca08d-665b-4d2b-8ad4-620fcf522db4/Eve.cn: 如此动静，草棚之内亦再难忽视，<NL>却见白鹿好似忽地惊醒般冲出草棚，虽有几分怯意，<NL>仍闷头杀入战阵，与玄鸮并肩而战…… <NL><NL>此时以二敌一，巨熊已然落于下风，见势不妙，终是落荒而逃……

5c3ca08d-665b-4d2b-8ad4-620fcf522db4/Opt.en: (Check the Dark Owl and White Deer for injuries...)
5c3ca08d-665b-4d2b-8ad4-620fcf522db4/Opt.ru: (Проверьте, нет ли травм у Темной Совы и Белого Оленя...)

65cdb30f-59e5-430a-87c8-f9acd65a2321/Eve.en: The great bear departs, and peace returns.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> inspects the surroundings of the Dark Owl and the White Deer, carefully examining them. Thankfully, neither appears harmed.<NL><NL>Though the beasts of the mountain still call out in the distance, the danger has passed, and the White Deer no longer trembles in fear.<NL>It tilts its head to glance at the Dark Owl, letting out a gentle cry. The Dark Owl flutters its wings in delight...
65cdb30f-59e5-430a-87c8-f9acd65a2321/Eve.cn: 巨熊既去，事态平息，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>再观玄鸮与白鹿周身，细细检查，好在并无伤势。<NL><NL>此时危机已去，纵然山中野兽号声仍在，白鹿却已不再害怕。 <NL>只见白鹿歪头瞧向玄鸮，轻鸣一声，玄鸮亦抖抖双翅，露出欢快神色……

65cdb30f-59e5-430a-87c8-f9acd65a2321/Opt.en: (It seems the White Deer understands the Dark Owl's protective heart...)
65cdb30f-59e5-430a-87c8-f9acd65a2321/Opt.cn: （看来白鹿亦是知晓玄鸮护她之心……）
65cdb30f-59e5-430a-87c8-f9acd65a2321/Opt.ru: (Кажется, Белый Олень понимает защитное сердце Темной Совы...)

68df226b-5da5-42da-9657-d45a9c55f1aa/Eve.en: The long night has yet to end,<NL>and the White Deer, now weary beyond measure, returns to the cottage.<NL>With the Dark Owl perched silently outside as its guardian, the White Deer finds no cause for fear and finally drifts into peaceful slumber...<NL><NL>Witnessing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels reassured and also retires indoors to rest...
68df226b-5da5-42da-9657-d45a9c55f1aa/Eve.cn: 长夜未尽，<NL>白鹿已是困倦累极，遂重回草棚之中。<NL>如今既有玄鸮立于草棚之外，静默守护，白鹿便是心无惧意，终能安心睡去……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见状，自感后顾无忧，亦返归屋中休息……

7f1a5643-3db2-4016-9286-a192a78f7282/Eve.en: At daybreak, stepping outside,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees the White Deer already full of spirit, chasing and playing with the Dark Owl across the countryside.<NL>They move in harmony, joyfully together, without a trace of distance between them...
7f1a5643-3db2-4016-9286-a192a78f7282/Eve.cn: 及至次日清晨，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行至屋外，<NL>便见白鹿已是精神焕发，正与玄鸮追逐嬉戏，徜徉乡野之间。<NL>相得甚欢，交洽无嫌……

0cf78579-7420-4b12-97c0-154c3c33b4b7/Eve.en: Yet the Dark Owl, large of frame and slow of motion by nature,<NL>now finds itself too sluggish to escape.<NL>Surrounded and attacked by a fierce giant eagle—clawed, pecked, battered—it soon becomes covered in wounds...
0cf78579-7420-4b12-97c0-154c3c33b4b7/Eve.cn: 然而玄鸮本就身形硕大，<NL>又惯于徐缓之动，如今缓不济急，<NL>一时竟寻不得脱战之机，只得受那巨鹰包围夹击，或抓或啄，以致遍体鳞伤……

0cf78579-7420-4b12-97c0-154c3c33b4b7/Opt.en: (The eagle is too ferocious to ignore!)

031b4851-50a4-4ad2-bae6-217ba80467ac/Eve.en: The savage eagle circles above, fierce and remorseless, seeming far beyond reach.<NL>Still, if <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> truly intends to act, there may yet be ways to deal with it.<NL>With resolve steeled, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> channels Qi and strikes—the power ripples outward, forcing the eagle back!<NL>Though daunted, the eagle does not flee far. It lingers at the edge of sight, unwilling to yield...<NL><NL>Just then, out of the corner of the eye, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> catches a figure crashing through the forest.<NL>It moves with reckless urgency—upon closer look, it is none other than the White Deer...
031b4851-50a4-4ad2-bae6-217ba80467ac/Eve.cn: 巨鹰凶暴狠厉，盘旋高空，好似力所难及，<NL>但若<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>当真欲要对付，亦能寻得些许手段。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中想定，随即出手，便以内力逼退巨鹰！<NL>然而那巨鹰受此震慑，虽暂避锋芒，却似有不甘，仍在不远不近之处徘徊不去……<NL><NL>恰在此时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>余光却瞥见林中一道身影，<NL>那身影不知何故，于林间横冲直撞，好似急不可耐，再定睛一看，原来竟是白鹿……

031b4851-50a4-4ad2-bae6-217ba80467ac/Opt.en: (Why is the White Deer so agitated...?)

e05b8b63-6911-48f7-9124-48e8bb51fc11/Eve.en: Puzzled, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> approaches.<NL>The White Deer paces to and fro, glancing skyward again and again, clearly alarmed at the sight of the Dark Owl under attack...
e05b8b63-6911-48f7-9124-48e8bb51fc11/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心生疑虑，几步行至白鹿身侧，<NL>但见白鹿于林中来回踱步，不时昂首望向高空，仿佛是见玄鸮受袭而焦急不已……
e05b8b63-6911-48f7-9124-48e8bb51fc11/Eve.ru: Озадаченный, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> приближается.<NL>Белый олень расхаживает взад-вперед, снова и снова поглядывая в небо, явно встревоженный видом Темной совы, подвергшейся Атаке...

e05b8b63-6911-48f7-9124-48e8bb51fc11/Opt.en: Could it be that your heart stirs with unrest, and you wish to help?
e05b8b63-6911-48f7-9124-48e8bb51fc11/Opt.cn: 莫非你心中不平，欲出手相助？
e05b8b63-6911-48f7-9124-48e8bb51fc11/Opt.ru: Может быть, ваше сердце тревожится, и вы хотите помочь?

e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Eve.en: After a brief thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> watches as the eagle swoops down once more.<NL>The Dark Owl now struggles to remain aloft.<NL>A sudden thought arises—<NL><NL>the White Deer is swift, nimble, and clearly cares for the Dark Owl's safety.<NL>If given guidance, it may assist <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> in striking down the eagle.<NL>When the Dark Owl falters and falls, the White Deer may leap forth and ensure its safe landing...
e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>稍作思索，<NL>眼看巨鹰又将袭来，而玄鸮已是摇摇欲坠，<NL>立时心生一念：<NL><NL>白鹿反应迅捷，行动灵巧，又有这番救护玄鸮之心，<NL>若为其指明对策，自己出手击退巨鹰，而白鹿从旁协助，<NL>待玄鸮支撑不住、终至坠落之时，白鹿正可挺身相助，护其周全……

e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Opt.en: (Offer counsel—urge the White Deer to aid...)
e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Opt.cn: （出谋划策，拜托白鹿挺身相助……）
e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Opt.ru: (Предложите совет — призовите Белого Оленя на помощь...)

e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Opt.en: (Ignore the White Deer—strike the eagle down at once!)
e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Opt.cn: （不管白鹿，即刻出手击落巨鹰！）
e019b067-1268-4841-8381-ca1dd8a565d0/Opt.ru: (Не обращайте внимания на Белого оленя — немедленно сразите орла!)

63880d31-1ec1-4cc2-957b-a50219e125d4/Eve.en: The situation is dire—no time to hesitate.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks skyward, lets out a sharp cry, and strikes!<NL>With only a fraction of Qi unleashed, a surge of invisible power tears through the air—trees shudder, winds howl.<NL>The giant eagles, caught in the blast, spiral in confusion. Their cries fill the sky, their menace scattered.<NL>They beat their wings in panic, fleeing without grace...
63880d31-1ec1-4cc2-957b-a50219e125d4/Eve.cn: 事态紧急，不容迟疑。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>重又望向空中，厉声一喝，随即出手！<NL>不过使出几成内力，便见无形之力瞬发而出，层林齐颤，狂风忽起，<NL>无数巨鹰受此内力震慑，更是天旋地转，不知方向，一时尖啸不止，再无半分凶悍之色，<NL>只得扑扇翅膀，狼狈而逃……

63880d31-1ec1-4cc2-957b-a50219e125d4/Opt.en: (Tend to the Dark Owl's wounds at once...)

ce9558cc-b470-4de1-9f66-c2a3643775d2/Eve.en: Now free of danger, the Dark Owl descends slowly.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> rushes forward and tends to its injuries...
ce9558cc-b470-4de1-9f66-c2a3643775d2/Eve.cn: 玄鸮得此解救，终能缓缓落地，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随即快步上前，抬手为玄鸮医治疗伤……
ce9558cc-b470-4de1-9f66-c2a3643775d2/Eve.ru: Теперь, когда опасность миновала, Темная сова медленно опускается.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> бросается вперед и ухаживает за своими ранами...

4d023bf9-29ea-4f3b-85ac-f340395e24ec/Eve.en: In the days that follow, the Dark Owl begins to heal.<NL>It expresses its gratitude to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> the only way it knows—by bringing fresh herbs and wild blooms each day without fail.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart is warmed—but thoughts turn to the White Deer...
4d023bf9-29ea-4f3b-85ac-f340395e24ec/Eve.cn: 此后数日，玄鸮伤势渐愈，<NL>自然对<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>满心感激，日日衔来林间花草，未曾停歇。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中熨帖，却又思及白鹿……

18ce7458-bb74-4faa-94bc-b0a01be13381/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> would think the White Deer would be at ease now that the Dark Owl is safe.<NL>Yet curiously, the White Deer no longer stays near the Dark Owl.<NL>Their interactions grow sparse, as if estranged...
18ce7458-bb74-4faa-94bc-b0a01be13381/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>本以为玄鸮得救，白鹿亦能安心，<NL>不知为何，如今白鹿却愈发不与玄鸮共处一地，二者鲜少交流，<NL>仿若已然生疏淡漠一般……

dcc59534-28e4-4843-9387-38b560b132c6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> shares these concerns aloud,<NL>recalling the moment of peril when the Dark Owl most needed its help.<NL><NL>The White Deer hears this but steps back, its eyes flickering with hesitation and fear...<NL>It seems burdened by some unseen worry...
dcc59534-28e4-4843-9387-38b560b132c6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将心中所想尽数细说，<NL>玄鸮遇此险境，正需白鹿挺身相助……<NL><NL>白鹿听得此话，却是后退半步，<NL>双眸微颤，显出几分退缩怯意，好似心有忧虑……

dcc59534-28e4-4843-9387-38b560b132c6/Opt.en: The danger draws near once again—there is no time to waste. With your help, the Dark Owl may yet survive!
dcc59534-28e4-4843-9387-38b560b132c6/Opt.cn: 事态紧急，不容迟疑。有你相助，玄鸮必能安然无恙！
dcc59534-28e4-4843-9387-38b560b132c6/Opt.ru: Опасность снова приближается — нельзя терять времени даром. С вашей помощью Темная сова еще может выжить!

d610a24a-f805-4e55-bef7-85c90bfcc193/Eve.en: Before words can finish, a sharp cry pierces the woodland.<NL>Together with the White Deer, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> rushes out. Looking up, another eagle descends upon the Dark Owl with deadly speed!<NL><NL>With a fierce shout, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> strikes again!<NL>With only a fraction of Qi unleashed, a surge of invisible power tears through the air—trees shudder, winds howl.<NL>The giant eagles, caught in the blast, spiral in confusion. Their cries fill the sky, their menace scattered.<NL>They beat their wings in panic, fleeing without grace...<NL><NL>Yet the Dark Owl, exhausted, can no longer hold himself aloft. He plummets from the sky!<NL>Falling from this height—if no one acts, the Dark Owl won't survive...
d610a24a-f805-4e55-bef7-85c90bfcc193/Eve.cn: 话语未尽，忽闻一声尖鸣，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与白鹿俱是冲出树林，抬头一望，便见巨鹰再朝玄鸮飞冲而去！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>厉声一喝，随即出手！ <NL>不过使出几成内力，便见无形之力瞬发而出，层林齐颤，狂风忽起，<NL>无数巨鹰受此内力震慑，更是天旋地转，不知方向，一时尖啸不止，再无半分凶悍之色，<NL>只得扑扇翅膀，狼狈而逃……<NL><NL>而玄鸮此时亦已无力支撑，竟自空中直坠而下！ <NL>自如此高空坠落，若再不施救，玄鸮必将粉身碎骨……

4950b2bd-8196-4283-a02b-d638627e5337/Eve.en: Like a flash of white lightning,<NL>the White Deer darts forward.<NL>In an instant, it leaps upward—precisely beneath the falling Dark Owl!<NL><NL>Though the Dark Owl is large and falling with force, the White Deer braces itself.<NL>Its knees bend, its body lowers into a crouch.<NL>With this, its avoids the incoming eagles and cushions the owl's fall, letting the Dark Owl slide safely to the earth...
4950b2bd-8196-4283-a02b-d638627e5337/Eve.cn: 眼前一道白影如星驰电发，<NL>霎时之间，白鹿已飞冲而去，<NL>不偏不倚，竟正正接住了不断下落的玄鸮！<NL><NL>只是玄鸮身形不小，下坠之力亦非寻常，<NL>受其冲击，白鹿立时身形一矮，四膝一屈，转为趴卧之态，<NL>如此一来，便再次避过飞掠而来的数只巨鹰，亦顺势令玄鸮稳稳地滑落平地……

2b18d853-dcfe-42ed-bc76-da172d055930/Eve.en: The danger abates, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> breathes easier.<NL>Yet the eagle still dares to dive! <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and the White Deer strike in unison.<NL>One person, one deer—fast and fierce. In no time, they wound the beast, driving it off in defeat...
2b18d853-dcfe-42ed-bc76-da172d055930/Eve.cn: 此时玄鸮危机暂解，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中稍安。<NL>却见那巨鹰竟仍欲俯冲而来，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随即与白鹿一道出手迎击，<NL>一人一鹿，迅捷灵巧，攻势凶猛无比，未久便将那巨鹰打得个个带伤，落荒而逃……

31535cc3-77b0-4eb2-9c2c-52f427856b2f/Eve.en: The eagles flee. The battle ends.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> stands still, slowly lowering hands before turning to the Dark Owl.<NL><NL>The White Deer steps forward, lowering its head to gently nuzzle the Dark Owl's disheveled wings.<NL>Worn from battle, the Dark Owl finally lets go of its tension and drifts into sleep...
31535cc3-77b0-4eb2-9c2c-52f427856b2f/Eve.cn: 巨鹰既去，事态平息，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>缓缓收手站定，才又望向玄鸮。<NL><NL>此时白鹿已缓步上前，垂首轻轻拱蹭玄鸮羽毛散乱的双翅，<NL>原来玄鸮经此一事，已是精疲力竭，此时逐渐放松下来，很早已沉入了安眠之中……

7d9a60dc-67e6-430e-bfa6-047220bbb4dc/Eve.en: In the days that follow, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> nurses the Dark Owl with care.<NL>The owl's injuries grows stronger, and his gratitude runs deep toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>—each day, he brings fresh herbs and forest gifts, never ceasing...
7d9a60dc-67e6-430e-bfa6-047220bbb4dc/Eve.cn: 此后数日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>为玄鸮医治疗伤，<NL>玄鸮伤势渐愈，自然对<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>满心感激，日日衔来林间花草，未曾停歇……

7d9a60dc-67e6-430e-bfa6-047220bbb4dc/Opt.en: Now that the Dark Owl recovers, the White Deer surely rejoices...
7d9a60dc-67e6-430e-bfa6-047220bbb4dc/Opt.cn: 玄鸮痊愈，想来白鹿亦是欣喜不已……
7d9a60dc-67e6-430e-bfa6-047220bbb4dc/Opt.ru: Теперь, когда Темная Сова выздоравливает, Белый Олень, несомненно, радуется...

c92a7ade-e6cd-4ff7-b3f8-bc632c1c89bc/Eve.en: Looking again to the deer, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees it often walking with the Dark Owl in the forest.<NL>Sometimes they search for food, sometimes they simply play.<NL>Always, they move as one, joyful and at ease...
c92a7ade-e6cd-4ff7-b3f8-bc632c1c89bc/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>再观白鹿，<NL>如今常常与玄鸮一道漫步山林，或是寻觅吃食，或是嬉闹戏乐，<NL>自是相得甚欢，交洽无嫌……

d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Eve.en: "To speak plainly...<NL>someone was indeed killed near here not long ago.<NL>If you have no business here, best not linger..."
d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Eve.cn: “不瞒你说……<NL>不久之前，这附近确实有人遇害，<NL>你若无事，可莫要在此逗留……”
d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Eve.ru: - Если говорить начистоту...<NL>не так давно неподалеку отсюда действительно кто-то был убит.<NL>Если у вас здесь нет никаких дел, лучше не задерживайтесь..."

d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Opt.en: Do you see the killer's face?
Do you know how the victim died?
d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Opt.cn: 你可知受害之人，是何死状……

d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Opt.en: Do you know the victim personally?
Are there any other suspicious occurrences...?
d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Opt.cn: 可还有其他令人生疑之事……
d97e729f-b7ff-442f-9c19-c9a7e29f83a4/Opt.ru: Есть ли еще какие-нибудь подозрительные происшествия...?

b6e58935-6b83-4136-866a-83f2714adfb7/Eve.en: "I didn't see it myself...<NL><NL>But I've heard it only moves at night—<NL>small in stature, clad in white. Whether true or not, I cannot say..."
b6e58935-6b83-4136-866a-83f2714adfb7/Eve.cn: “我倒不曾亲眼见过……<NL><NL>不过我听闻，此人只在夜间行动，<NL>体形娇小，身着白衣，不知是真是假……”
b6e58935-6b83-4136-866a-83f2714adfb7/Eve.ru: - Сам я этого не видел...<NL><NL>Но я слышал, что он движется только ночью—<NL>маленького роста, одетый в белое. Правда это или нет, я не могу сказать..."

b6e58935-6b83-4136-866a-83f2714adfb7/Opt.en: (Small in stature... clad in white... sounds not unlike Bai Wuyang...)
b6e58935-6b83-4136-866a-83f2714adfb7/Opt.cn: （体形娇小，身着白衣……听来倒与白无恙前辈有几分相似……）
b6e58935-6b83-4136-866a-83f2714adfb7/Opt.ru: (Маленького роста... одет в белое... звучит совсем как Бай Уян...)

d2c4e21a-8cac-42fd-aebd-f7dc69c0dbc9/Eve.en: "It's... horrifying to speak of.<NL>The victims were found with chests torn open, internal organs gone without a trace.<NL>Some say it was the white demon from the underworld, claiming souls...<NL><NL>I hear disciples from the Valley of Flowers are investigating this—might as well inquire of them..."
d2c4e21a-8cac-42fd-aebd-f7dc69c0dbc9/Eve.cn: “这……说来实在可怕，<NL>那些受害之人胸肚大开，体内五脏六腑……皆消失无踪，<NL>大家都在说定是地府的白无常来索命了……<NL><NL>听闻百花弟子也在查探此事，你不妨去问问他们……”

d2c4e21a-8cac-42fd-aebd-f7dc69c0dbc9/Opt.en: (In that case... best speak with the Valley of Flowers disciple...)
d2c4e21a-8cac-42fd-aebd-f7dc69c0dbc9/Opt.cn: （如此……不妨前去询问百花弟子……）
d2c4e21a-8cac-42fd-aebd-f7dc69c0dbc9/Opt.ru: (В таком случае... лучше всего поговорить с учеником из Долины цветов...)

a47d50b6-4097-48e1-afb0-c49c4a7cf820/Eve.en: "I did not know the victim, nor do I know where they came from.<NL>However, I heard a disciple from the Valley of Flowers went to investigate—perhaps they hold the key..."
a47d50b6-4097-48e1-afb0-c49c4a7cf820/Eve.cn: “我并不认得受害之人，亦不知他从何处而来，<NL>听闻恰有百花弟子前去查探，或许知晓其中关窍……”
a47d50b6-4097-48e1-afb0-c49c4a7cf820/Eve.ru: "Я не был знаком с жертвой и не знаю, откуда они взялись.<NL>Однако я слышал, что ученик из Долины цветов отправился на разведку — возможно, у них есть ключ..."

a47d50b6-4097-48e1-afb0-c49c4a7cf820/Opt.en: (In that case... best speak with the Valley of Flowers disciple...)
a47d50b6-4097-48e1-afb0-c49c4a7cf820/Opt.cn: （如此……不妨前去询问百花弟子……）
a47d50b6-4097-48e1-afb0-c49c4a7cf820/Opt.ru: (В таком случае... лучше всего поговорить с учеником из Долины цветов...)

505c4411-e01a-43a0-913e-8538884c94ba/Eve.en: <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> reflects deeply, but can think of nothing more...
505c4411-e01a-43a0-913e-8538884c94ba/Eve.cn: <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>冥思良久，已是再想不到更多……
505c4411-e01a-43a0-913e-8538884c94ba/Eve.ru: <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> глубоко задумывается, но больше ни о чем не может думать...

505c4411-e01a-43a0-913e-8538884c94ba/Opt.en: (Might as well speak with the Valley of Flowers disciple...)
505c4411-e01a-43a0-913e-8538884c94ba/Opt.ru: (С таким же успехом можно было бы поговорить с учеником из Долины цветов...)

693e5f4d-7819-4d52-bbc1-9358e5509a91/Eve.en: "A human life is no trifling matter.<NL>After the crime was reported, the Valley Leader sent us to investigate.<NL>We've scouted both openly and in secret for days, and now have some leads.<NL><NL>If you have questions, ask freely..."
693e5f4d-7819-4d52-bbc1-9358e5509a91/Eve.cn: “人命关天，孰能坐视不理……<NL>听闻此间凶案过后，谷主便派我等前往调查，<NL>我等明察暗访多日，终于有了些许眉目，<NL><NL>你若有何不解之处，只管询问便是……”

693e5f4d-7819-4d52-bbc1-9358e5509a91/Opt.en: Are there any other suspicious occurrences...?
693e5f4d-7819-4d52-bbc1-9358e5509a91/Opt.cn: 不知可还有其他令人生疑之事么……
693e5f4d-7819-4d52-bbc1-9358e5509a91/Opt.ru: Есть ли еще какие-нибудь подозрительные происшествия...?

7e8df62f-0f9d-4f07-b761-29768c9fe184/Eve.en: "This killing method... it's certainly bizarre.<NL><NL>Though the techniques used vary, all involve disembowelment, and the removal of the heart and liver.<NL>Yet strangely, the execution resembles the arts of our Valley of Flowers...<NL>and in its profundity, perhaps even surpasses that of our elders..."<NL><NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>'s expression grows grim and <Character key=CharacterId str=GenderPossessive/> tone confused...
7e8df62f-0f9d-4f07-b761-29768c9fe184/Eve.cn: “若说这杀人手法，着实奇诡……<NL><NL>受害之人虽是被以不同手段开膛破肚，摘心取肝，<NL>但那凶手施功之法……竟与我百花谷颇为相似，<NL>只是其间精深玄奥之处，恐怕连谷中前辈也是不及……”<NL><NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>神情愁苦，语气颇是疑惑……

7e8df62f-0f9d-4f07-b761-29768c9fe184/Opt.en: (It does seem... this may indeed involve Bai Wuyang...)
7e8df62f-0f9d-4f07-b761-29768c9fe184/Opt.cn: （听来……倒似真与白无恙前辈有关……）
7e8df62f-0f9d-4f07-b761-29768c9fe184/Opt.ru: (Похоже... это действительно может быть связано с Бай Уяном...)

db3cbc8d-5ac4-4743-9048-5e148bf01d06/Eve.en: Though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> holds some suspicions, the matter concerns a respected elder of the Valley of Flowers.<NL>With the truth yet unrevealed, it would be unwise to speak freely before the disciples of the Valley of Flowers...
db3cbc8d-5ac4-4743-9048-5e148bf01d06/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽有猜测，然事关百花谷前辈，<NL>而今既未查明真相，恐怕不便与百花谷弟子多言……

6d5f1d48-ab51-4810-9780-ddbfd55ec342/Eve.en: "There is one matter that stirs unease...<NL><NL>Earlier, my sectmates and I sought to mend the broken bodies of the fallen.<NL>When channeling breath into their forms, we discovered that each of their Dantian bore earth's might that holds the heavenly might—<NL>without exception..."
6d5f1d48-ab51-4810-9780-ddbfd55ec342/Eve.cn: “确有一事，令人生疑……<NL><NL>此前我与同门为修补一众死者尸身，曾引气入死者体内，<NL>竟意外发现他们丹田之中皆呈归元化蕴，承天载物之象，<NL>无一例外……”

6d5f1d48-ab51-4810-9780-ddbfd55ec342/Opt.en: (Time is of the essence. Seek out one who wields <FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> Qi and test the truth...)
6d5f1d48-ab51-4810-9780-ddbfd55ec342/Opt.cn: （事不宜迟，还需尽快寻一<FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/>内力之人，一试究竟……）
6d5f1d48-ab51-4810-9780-ddbfd55ec342/Opt.ru: (Время имеет решающее значение. Ищи того, кто владеет <FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> Ци и проверь истину...)

24ab808b-67cc-45a9-8a4b-ac86d89c00c1/Eve.en: "There is one matter that stirs unease...<NL><NL>Earlier, my sectmates and I sought to mend the broken bodies of the fallen.<NL>When channeling breath into their forms, we discovered that each of their Dantian bore the signs of Chilling Yin, the mighty Kun beast retreating to northern seas—<NL>without exception..."
24ab808b-67cc-45a9-8a4b-ac86d89c00c1/Eve.cn: “确有一事，令人生疑……<NL><NL>此前我与同门为修补一众死者尸身，曾引气入死者体内，<NL>竟意外发现他们丹田之中皆呈玄阴冰寒，鲲隐北溟之象，<NL>无一例外……”

24ab808b-67cc-45a9-8a4b-ac86d89c00c1/Opt.en: (Time is of the essence. Seek out one who wields <FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/> Qi and test the truth...)
24ab808b-67cc-45a9-8a4b-ac86d89c00c1/Opt.cn: （事不宜迟，还需尽快寻一<FiveElement key=FiveElementType str=Name/>内力之人，一试究竟……）

2f1cd199-ef0e-471f-9a7b-c7ff23e17fb6/Eve.en: Upon entering the village, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> recalls the scenes from a distant dream.<NL><NL>More than three centuries ago, it was in this very Taiwu Village that the great Demonbane War took place.<NL>There, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> parted from Feng Qing, torn between life and death, a sorrow etched deep in memory.<NL>Yet now, the world has changed beyond recognition. Today, the Dark Owl and the White Deer revisit this place, their old home. As they gaze upon familiar sights, sorrow stirs within their hearts—<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, too, feels a faint melancholy...
2f1cd199-ef0e-471f-9a7b-c7ff23e17fb6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随之入村，继而忆起梦中旧事。<NL><NL>三百多年前，便是在这太吾村中，<NL>一场封魔大战，终与冯青生离死别，百般悲切，如今却也物是人非。<NL>今日玄鸮与白鹿重游故地，难免睹物伤情，便是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中，亦生出几分怅然……

2f1cd199-ef0e-471f-9a7b-c7ff23e17fb6/Opt.en: (More than three centuries, fleeting as mist...)

cd45845a-e085-42db-a70c-484115136a4a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wishes to present a gift,<NL>yet there is no Yin Herb favored by the Dark Owl in the Travel Bag. Reluctantly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sets the thought aside...
cd45845a-e085-42db-a70c-484115136a4a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽欲赠礼，<NL>行囊之中，却并无玄鸮所喜爱的阴性药材，只得暂且作罢……

5556205c-69a1-4bfe-a445-803574180630/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wishes to present a gift,<NL>yet there is no Yang Herb favored by the White Deer in the Travel Bag. Reluctantly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sets the thought aside...
5556205c-69a1-4bfe-a445-803574180630/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽欲赠礼，<NL>行囊之中，并无白鹿所喜爱的阳性药材，只得暂且作罢……

e263db09-a1bf-4c67-9523-68120b08a2d9/Eve.en: That day, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> catches sight of the Dark Owl gliding past, wings stretched wide,<NL>as though at leisure, savoring the peaceful scenery of the Taiwu Village.<NL>It perches upon rooftops and treetops,<NL>preening its feathers with unhurried grace...
e263db09-a1bf-4c67-9523-68120b08a2d9/Eve.cn: 此日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽见玄鸮双翅伸展，滑翔而过，<NL>好似是闲来无事，正徜徉于太吾村中欣赏村中景致。<NL>只见玄鸮时而驻足屋舍，时而停留树梢，<NL>梳理羽毛，自得其乐……

f8ad22c9-cd12-4522-878e-570e0754fda5/Eve.en: Soon, the Dark Owl seems to notice <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>It swoops down with a soft cry, as if greeting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
f8ad22c9-cd12-4522-878e-570e0754fda5/Eve.cn: 未久，玄鸮似是瞧见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>复又展翅飞来，轻鸣一声，好似在与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>问好一般……
f8ad22c9-cd12-4522-878e-570e0754fda5/Eve.ru: Вскоре Темная сова, кажется, замечает <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Он пикирует вниз с тихим криком, словно приветствуя <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...

9b6dc90b-1920-470d-9e8e-f2ff449d3eb9/Eve.en: Amused, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> returns the greeting.<NL>The Dark Owl chirps with joy, gently drops a small object from its beak into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hands,<NL>and takes flight once more, disappearing into the distance...
9b6dc90b-1920-470d-9e8e-f2ff449d3eb9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>亦觉有趣，<NL>便也向玄鸮轻轻问好，玄鸮面露喜悦，<NL>将口中所衔之物交予<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，方才飞向远处……

0bfac0cb-d58e-4407-be7c-c9ebe6a2a6f4/Eve.en: That day, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> glimpses the White Deer treading lightly upon a path strewn with petals,<NL>as if wandering through the Taiwu Village with no particular aim, admiring the scenery at its own pace.<NL>At times it sniffs the wild grass, at times it gazes across the fields—<NL>moving with ease and quiet delight...
0bfac0cb-d58e-4407-be7c-c9ebe6a2a6f4/Eve.cn: 此日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽见白鹿步履轻盈，踏花而来，<NL>似是闲来无事，正于太吾村中漫步，欣赏村中景致。<NL>只见白鹿时而轻嗅草叶，时而眺望田野，<NL>优游流离，自得其乐……

770e03ff-41d1-4cf2-b708-b51139e8ebb7/Eve.en: One day, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees the Dark Owl and White Deer walking together through the Taiwu Village.<NL>The Dark Owl soars and settles, the White Deer treads with silent steps;<NL>side by side, they roam the land of their memories, sharing the quiet beauty of the present...
770e03ff-41d1-4cf2-b708-b51139e8ebb7/Eve.cn: 此日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽见太吾村中，<NL>玄鸮与白鹿正相伴而行，玄鸮时飞时落，白鹿微步漾尘，<NL>似乎闲来无事，正一同漫步太吾村中，共赏风景……

1a374576-a289-458b-85fb-7e2dd1acb62c/Eve.en: Soon, the White Deer catches sight of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>It walks slowly forward, and gently nudges <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with its antlers, as if nodding in gratitude toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
1a374576-a289-458b-85fb-7e2dd1acb62c/Eve.cn: 未久，白鹿似是瞧见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，<NL>复又缓步行来，鹿角轻蹭<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，好似在与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>颔首致意一般……

307111ce-81ae-4ebe-8f17-efadf7c7b1d8/Eve.en: Amused, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> returns the nod.<NL>The White Deer gazes back with warmth,<NL>drops the item it carries from its mouth into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hands, and then turns to leave...
307111ce-81ae-4ebe-8f17-efadf7c7b1d8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>亦觉有趣，<NL>便也向白鹿颔首致意，白鹿目露欣然，<NL>将口中所衔之物交予<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，方才转身离去……

77a96520-5f5a-4e19-b6e7-1c96554dfd79/Eve.en: Soon after, the Dark Owl and the White Deer reach the Taiwu Ancestral Temple.<NL>They come to a halt before it. One deer, one owl—both gaze upon the old site with a look of quiet yearning...
77a96520-5f5a-4e19-b6e7-1c96554dfd79/Eve.cn: 未久，便见玄鸮与白鹿已行至太吾祠堂前，<NL>一时双双驻足不前，一鹿一鸮，眼中竟流露几分眷恋怀念之色……
77a96520-5f5a-4e19-b6e7-1c96554dfd79/Eve.ru: Вскоре после этого Темная сова и Белый олень достигают храма предков Тайу.<NL>Они останавливаются перед ним. Один олень, одна сова — оба смотрят на старое место с выражением тихой тоски...

5f447c93-7370-4975-a8a4-6948d437b8cd/Eve.en: Though time has passed, memories linger.<NL>The Dark Owl and the White Deer dwell here in peace, their days tranquil and free.<NL>Yet when they return to familiar ground, the past calls, and grief returns.<NL><NL>Seeing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sighs inwardly.<NL>In the days that follow, the two often come here again—nestled together beneath the shrine, lingering in silence...
5f447c93-7370-4975-a8a4-6948d437b8cd/Eve.cn: 往事虽已逝，旧忆却难消去。<NL>玄鸮与白鹿长居此处，虽觉万事喜乐太平，优哉游哉，<NL>然而故地重游，忆起前人，亦难免感怀心伤……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见此，心中一时叹息，<NL>此后更见玄鸮白鹿常常漫步至此，依偎而卧，徘徊不去……

8fa734d1-f7c4-44c5-8b8e-bad530e1a984/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wishes to play with the White Deer,<NL>yet this is no ordinary beast. It raises its head, then turns toward the forest,<NL>as if inviting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> to a contest—testing speed and grace among the trees...
8fa734d1-f7c4-44c5-8b8e-bad530e1a984/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽欲与白鹿嬉戏玩耍，<NL>白鹿却非寻常灵兽，头颅一昂，扭头朝向山林之中，<NL>似乎欲与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>追逐林间，一较灵巧迅捷之高下……

51d20739-941f-4931-92c6-055a40cbf53e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> accepts the challenge.<NL>Together, they dart into the woods, moving like wind.<NL>Breath held, Qi raised—<NL><NL>after a breathless dash through wind and dust, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> takes the lead...<NL>The White Deer looks back with approval, and shakes loose all the herbs it has gathered, offering them as a gift to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
51d20739-941f-4931-92c6-055a40cbf53e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随即应允，<NL>与白鹿一同飞身遁入山林之中，<NL>各自提气而奔，欲要一较高下……<NL><NL>如此风驰电掣，一路穿行，终是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>快上一步，<NL>白鹿目露赞许之色，便将一路寻来的草药自身上抖落，尽数留给了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

5d251a0f-56a5-4217-9e9e-c8ea92aa3b6e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> wishes to play with the Dark Owl,<NL>yet this too is no ordinary beast. It flaps its wings, then glances toward the woodland.<NL>There, wild boars roam, unaware of the presence of the Dark Owl and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>The Dark Owl's gaze is keen—perhaps it wishes to hunt with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, testing resolve and focus...
5d251a0f-56a5-4217-9e9e-c8ea92aa3b6e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>虽欲与玄鸮嬉戏玩耍，<NL>玄鸮却非寻常灵兽，双翅一拍，扭头朝向山林之中。<NL>只见林中正有山猪流连，此时未曾察觉玄鸮与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之气息，<NL>而玄鸮目光炯炯，似乎欲与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>同去捕猎，一较心志毅力之高下……

7544faf2-baa6-4fc1-9d4b-b8978411fee5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> accepts the challenge.<NL>Together, they slip silently into the forest,<NL>each taking their place in hiding, awaiting the right moment...<NL><NL>With patience and precision, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> secures the hunt.<NL>The Dark Owl looks back with approval, and shakes loose all the herbs it has gathered, offering them as a gift to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
7544faf2-baa6-4fc1-9d4b-b8978411fee5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>随即应允，<NL>与玄鸮一同无声潜入入山林之中，<NL>各自潜伏暗处，欲要一较高下……<NL><NL>如此沉心静气，静待时机，终是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>猎得山猪，<NL>玄鸮目露赞许之色，便将此次寻来的草药自身上抖落，尽数留给了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……

8723a264-39e1-406d-8ce0-b598418fbf57/Eve.en: "The two founders of the Valley of Flowers,<NL>are in truth none other than the White Deer and the Dark Owl. They care not for life in the valley, but roam freely under heaven.<NL>Though I dwell in the Valley of Flowers, I've never seen them return.<NL>If you ask me when they will come back... I could not say."
8723a264-39e1-406d-8ce0-b598418fbf57/Eve.cn: “我百花谷二位祖师，<NL>实则乃是玄鸮白鹿所化，却不爱长居谷中，只爱云游四方。<NL>我身在百花谷，却从未见过二位祖师返归，<NL>你若要问我，我自然也不知，祖师何日才会归来……”

91ec64f3-a44e-455f-9252-e323eaaa5243/Eve.en: "I've heard the tale from the Valley Leader.<NL>Some say the founders are the Dark Owl and White Deer themselves. One loves black, the other white—<NL>thus the old tale goes. But who knows if there is truth to it..."
91ec64f3-a44e-455f-9252-e323eaaa5243/Eve.cn: “二位祖师之事，我亦曾听谷主说起……<NL>或应二位祖师本为白鹿玄鸮，故而一人喜爱白色，一人喜爱黑色，<NL>此番传言，也不知是真是假……”

d0b0de80-ba2e-48ba-8d4b-dc04272d5f28/Eve.en: "The founders?<NL>Such figures I have never seen. Even among my elders, none speak of them with certainty.<NL>They seem like immortals—far beyond our reach. As for where they are now... I cannot begin to guess."
d0b0de80-ba2e-48ba-8d4b-dc04272d5f28/Eve.cn: “二位祖师？<NL>如此人物，别说我从未亲眼见过，便是听师兄师姐提起，<NL>听着也如同那天上的神仙一般遥不可及，更不知晓，二位祖师如今身在何方了……”

5d82efcf-822c-4391-8f93-e4174876b010/Eve.en: One day, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> comes seeking Xuan Wuyou,<NL>only to find the Dark Owl perched still upon a branch, wings folded like a ball of down.<NL>At the sight of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, it tilts its head, eyes wide, as if asking <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> What brings <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> here...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Due to the use of the Octomancy Requiem,<NL>Xuan Wuyou has exhausted all strength, and returned to the form of the Dark Owl.<NL>It may take time for recovery before human form can be resumed...)</color>
5d82efcf-822c-4391-8f93-e4174876b010/Eve.cn: 此日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>来寻玄无忧，<NL>却见玄鸮静立一截树枝之上，双翅收拢，状如毛球，<NL>一见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，便微微歪头，双目圆睁，好似欲问<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>所为何事……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因施为八生八死之法，以死化生，<NL>玄无忧耗尽气力，重又化为玄鸮。<NL>或需静待时日，只待玄鸮修身养气，恢复力量之后，方能重现人形……）</color>

aadc95a3-1b3e-4d92-bb73-7c337ced7e12/Eve.en: The Dark Owl, drained of strength, hovers on the edge of sleep.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gently strokes its feathers, speaking softly.<NL>The Dark Owl settles with ease, and slowly drifts into slumber...
aadc95a3-1b3e-4d92-bb73-7c337ced7e12/Eve.cn: 玄鸮已是气力耗尽，欲眠未眠，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>此时并无要事，旋即轻抚玄鸮羽翅，出言温声宽慰，<NL>随着这番安抚，玄鸮心下安宁，方才渐渐睡去……

06990656-4c88-4409-baeb-69b043478664/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> explains the purpose of the visit.<NL>The Dark Owl flutters its wings lightly, letting out a low, throaty cry—there is worry in its voice...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(The Dark Owl and White Deer's strength wanes; to enact this method now may bring harm...)</color>
06990656-4c88-4409-baeb-69b043478664/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将来意说明，<NL>玄鸮双翅轻拍，喉中便是一声咕咕，似有几分忧虑……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因玄鸮与白鹿力量减弱，此时施为此法，或将有所减益……）</color>

23da8e0c-be07-4fe0-b7e0-f57fe066c579/Eve.en: One day, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> comes seeking Bai Wuyang,<NL>only to find the White Deer lying beneath a great tree, limbs folded, its body like a white dumpling.<NL>At the sight of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, it utters a gentle sound, ears flicking, as if asking <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> What brings <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> here...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Due to the use of the Octomancy Requiem,<NL>Bai Wuyang has exhausted all strength, and returned to the form of the White Deer.<NL>It may take time for recovery before human form can be resumed...)</color>
23da8e0c-be07-4fe0-b7e0-f57fe066c579/Eve.cn: 此日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>来寻白无恙，<NL>却见白鹿静卧参天树下，四肢收拢，状如糕团，<NL>一见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，便轻鸣一声，双耳抖动，好似欲问<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>所为何事……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（因施为八生八死之法，以死化生，<NL>白无恙耗尽气力，重又化为白鹿。<NL>或需静待时日，只待白鹿修身养气，恢复力量之后，方能重现人形……）</color>

b6933a2d-f4d9-4a66-a0e8-ce8ef4a9d191/Eve.en: The White Deer, drained of strength, hovers on the edge of sleep.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gently strokes its antlers, speaking softly.<NL>The White Deer settles with ease, and slowly drifts into slumber...
b6933a2d-f4d9-4a66-a0e8-ce8ef4a9d191/Eve.cn: 白鹿已是气力耗尽，欲眠未眠，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>此时并无要事，旋即轻抚白鹿长角，出言温声宽慰，<NL>随着这番安抚，白鹿心下安宁，方才渐渐睡去……

80b9057b-15e7-40ea-bb33-60019debbb16/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> explains the purpose of the visit.<NL>The White Deer stands, tail swaying, faint unease in its gaze...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(The White Deer and Dark Owl's strength wanes; to enact this method now may bring harm...)</color>
